name: JustRoute autorouter
description: Batch autorouter: routes unrouted nets around existing copper, honors netclass rules and rule areas, adds results as one undoable commit.
description_full: JustRoute is a grid-based batch autorouter with best-state retention, blame-directed rip-up, and PathFinder-style negotiated congestion. It reads the board natively (all dialects v4 through the v11 nightlies), treats existing tracks/vias/rule-areas/graphics as fixed obstacles, routes only what is unrouted, and emits per-netclass track widths and via sizes. Routed traces are smoothed off the grid staircase (optionally with rounded corner fillets). Runs as an external IPC process (CPU-only, headless engine); results are written back as a single undoable commit and copper pours are refilled. KiCad's own DRC is the release judge - every gate sample of harvested boards certifies with zero new violations.
